page.title: Know your cash before you decide how to use it.
page.description: Record real deposits, dividends, and trade cash flows. The same cash balance then guides your portfolio references.

form.title: Keep real cash movements in the notebook
form.description: Record what already happened, not a forecast. Buys, sells, and received dividends need a stock attached.

form.stockHint: Buys, sells, and received dividends need a related stock.

guide.title: One entry makes three places clearer.
guide.description: Record what happened, then return to the other pages for an updated reference.

steps.title: Record the real movement
steps.description: Use the date it happened for deposits, dividends, buys, and sells.

steps.description: Save the entry and reload to see the new cash position.

steps.description: The budget helps calculate each stock’s suggested amount.
